hyp:logistic_cv_lambda.statement: L2 regularization improves cross-validated Brier score on logistic regression; optimal lambda in [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0] will be identified through 5-fold contiguous block CV

hyp:interaction_features.statement: Interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) may improve model performance; statistical significance tested via paired t-test across folds

hyp:model_compression.statement: Model compression via sparsity and quantization can be applied with minimal Brier score degradation; optimal config balances sparsity level and bit precision

claim:best_lambda_0p1.statement: L2 regularization with lambda=0.1 achieves the lowest 5-fold CV Brier score (0.207077) among tested lambdas [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0], improving baseline (lambda=0) by 0.00890 Brier units

claim:interaction_significant.statement: Interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) significantly improve logistic regression at lambda=0.1 with paired t-statistic=3.91 > 2.0, reducing mean Brier by 0.0257 across 5 folds

claim:best_compression.statement: Model compression with sparsity=20% and 4-bit quantization retains 99.92% of dense-model Brier performance (retention=0.9992, Brier: 0.141762 dense vs 0.141873 compressed), making it the optimal compression configuration
